goal: Resume an interrupted node reindex from the last completed block file
Avoids restarting from the very first block file and losing hours or days of indexing work
reviewability: Author has been silent for 139 days, so reviews may wait a long time for a response
agreement: Adds database complexity without evidence of meaningful overhead or restart improvement (maflcko)
May be unnecessary because restarting without reindex already skips re-indexing on master (mzumsande)
Concerns about slowing the happy path were addressed by saving only on interrupt (maflcko, mzumsande)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because resuming an interrupted reindex avoids repeating work across processed block files
The benefit is marginal because restarting without reindex already avoids reprocessing blocks on disk
